look: Wooden buildings with tiled roofs, restaurants and wine shops with flags, and a high wall with big gate towers. Kaifeng was the capital of the Song dynasty.
Long robes with wide sleeves for officials and scholars; short jackets and trousers for porters and boatmen; cloth caps and straw hats.
Boats and barges on the river, carrying grain to the capital. On land: donkeys, camels, ox carts, sedan chairs and wheelbarrows.
Oil lamps and lanterns. Kaifeng's night markets stayed busy long after dark.
Perhaps a million people lived in and around the city, one of the largest in the world. In 1127 it fell to invaders from the north.

stops.name: Boats on the Bian river
stops.title: Along the River During the Qingming Festival (detail)
stops.note: Details from a famous handscroll by Zhang Zeduan, more than five metres long.

spots.d: Big boats brought rice and grain along the canal to feed the capital.
spots.how: Records of the time describe hundreds of grain boats a year.

spots.d: Inns and eating houses lined the bank, for boatmen and travellers.
spots.how: Zhang Zeduan painted every shop and sign along the river.

spots.d: Boatmen used poles and long ropes to move heavy boats.
spots.how: You can see the lines stretched from the boats.

stops.name: The Rainbow Bridge
stops.title: Along the River During the Qingming Festival (detail): the Rainbow Bridge

spots.d: A wooden arch bridge with no posts in the water, so big boats could pass underneath. Stalls crowd both sides.
spots.how: Song-dynasty builders made these from interlocking timbers.

spots.d: Boats crowd the water near the bridge, and people on the bridge lean over to watch.
spots.how: The scroll is famous for this busy scene.

spots.d: Traders sell food and goods under big umbrellas.
spots.how: Every stall in the painting is different.

stops.name: The city gate
stops.title: Along the River During the Qingming Festival (detail): the city gate

spots.d: A tall wooden tower on a thick earth wall guarded the way into the capital.
spots.how: Kaifeng's old walls have been dug up by archaeologists.

spots.d: Officials in long robes, workers in short jackets, and riders all pass along the road.
spots.how: The painter showed over 800 people in the whole scroll.
